audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was given to Cassiopeia while its own why says 'you win the early body-block and keep Skaarl's health full', and 2+ items was given to Cassiopeia while its why says 'you reclaim the side-lane duel'.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Kled,Skill,Cassiopeia,Cassiopeia,Cassiopeia,Cassiopeia,Kled — Kled at Level 1 and at 2+ items, exactly where the whys already point. Cassiopeia has one of the weakest level 1s and no dash to escape a two-item Kled once Miasma is spent.
audit.corrected: Level 1 and 2+ items flipped to Kled in both layers, ratings raised from 2/10 to 6/10. The middle stages stay Cassiopeia's, which the 8.5/10 difficulty and her grounding both support.

audit.whatIsWrong: No power-spike carried a cooldown; the packet counts zero sequencing cues on the whole matchup.
audit.why: Miasma is 24/22/20/18/16s — the longest lane cooldown in this matchup by a distance, and the entire Kled plan is 'commit while it is down'. Petrifying Gaze is 120/100/80s.
audit.corrected: 24s written into dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns; 120s into breakdown.cooldowns and whys[4]; Bear Trap's 11s into dontsFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Petrifying Gaze was described as a flat 'face-stun' with no mention that turning away downgrades it, and Twin Fang's healing was never mentioned anywhere.
audit.why: Riot's R text: 'stunning any enemies in front of her that are facing her and slowing any others with their back turned' — turning Kled away converts a stun into a slow, which is the single most actionable fact about her ultimate. Riot's E text: 'deals increased damage to Poisoned targets and heals her for a percentage of the damage dealt' — that heal is what wins her the long trade, so Grievous Wounds timing decides it.
audit.corrected: whys[4] and wants.foe[2] state the facing condition; dontsFull[0].d ties Grievous Wounds to Twin Fang; dontsFull[2].d states that Miasma kills both Kled's E dash and his R charge.

audit.whatIsWrong: Zero 'wait for X before you Y' lines despite the whole win condition depending on one cooldown.
audit.why: Miasma at 24s rank 1 is a two-and-a-half-wave window; naming the number is what makes 'commit when it is down' usable.

edits.before: Grounds you — dashes and movement abilities are disabled inside it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Miasma is 24s at rank 1 and grounds you — no E dash, no R charge inside it. Bait it, then commit.

edits.before: That is Cassiopeia's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Twin Fang heals her off every poisoned tick — Grievous Wounds before long trades.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Bear Trap is 11s and your only pin — save it for her, not minions.

edits.before: Giving away the dismount for free — mounted HP is a resource; spending it on poke instead of all-ins loses the lane.
edits.after: Inside Miasma your E dash and R charge are both dead — walk out of the cloud before you spend either of them.

edits.before: - Cassiopeia Miasma: matchup-defining — Grounds you — dashes and movement abilities are disabled inside it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Cassiopeia Miasma: matchup-defining — 24s at rank 1, grounds you, so dashes and movement abilities die inside it. Track it before every engage. - Petrifying Gaze: 120s, only stuns if you face her. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.before: Track Cassiopeia's Miasma: Grounds you — dashes and movement abilities are disabled inside it. When it is down — Q-trap + courage all-in.
edits.after: Track Miasma: 24s at rank 1, grounds you so your E dash and R charge both die. When it is down — Q-trap and courage all-in.

edits.before: Petrifying Gaze (R) face-stuns your Charge engage and her W grounds the dash — she owns the level 6 window outright.
edits.after: Petrifying Gaze (R) at 120s stuns only if you face her — turn away and it is just a slow, but Miasma still grounds the charge.

edits.before: Land Petrifying Gaze (R) facing you to face-stun your engage and burst you in the dismount window
edits.after: Catch you facing her with Petrifying Gaze (R) so it stuns you instead of only slowing you

notes: The packet flagged 'Land Petrifying Gaze' in wants.foe[2] as a probable wrong name — it is a FALSE POSITIVE, Petrifying Gaze is the correct Riot name for her R. spikes[3].when reads 'Lvl 2-3', duplicating spikes[0].when, so the fourth spike is labelled as an early-game timing while the slot is the late-game one; the string is 7 characters and therefore under the applier's 25-char skip threshold, so it cannot be repaired by a normal edit and needs a direct fix. Cassiopeia's E has a 0.75s cooldown and her Q 3.5s — neither is a trackable window, which is why all sequencing advice is keyed to Miasma.
